items.item_text: Certified Phlebotomy Technician certificate from LFS, DPH, CA (CA CPT I LICENSE)
Heartsaver certification or Basic Life Support (BLS) certification
1 year of clinical laboratory experience including knowledge of instrument operation, specimen processing, knowledge of specimen send-outs, and/or microbiology specimen processing
Five years of clinical laboratory experience or two years of college preferred
One year acute care hospital experience preferred
Familiarity and compliance with general laboratory safety practices, MSDS guidelines, State of California regulations andrequirements, OSHA standards, CDC recommendation and universal precautions.
Participates in, and successfully completes technical competency testing in each area of job performance on a regular basis to meet established requirements.

Under the direction of a CLS, receive and process specimens within expected timelines. Evaluate specimens based on established guidelines for appropriateness of specimen vs. tests ordered, appropriateness of sample volume and the frequency of test orders
Under the direction of a CLS, operate specific automated equipment when measurement, standardization or calibration is not required by the operator.
Prepare specimens and necessary paperwork to accompany specimens referred to a reference laboratory.
Receive, process, plant and incubate specimens for bacterial culture.
Evaluate specimens based on established guidelines for appropriateness of specimen vs. tests ordered, appropriateness of sample volume and frequency of test orders.
Prepare and stain smears for Gram stain, Kinyoun stain and trichrome stain. Prepare wet preps.
Receive and process blood culture specimens. Operate necessary automated equipment when measurement, standardization or calibration is not required by the operator.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Under the direction of a CLS, perform instrument maintenance required for various automated equipment.
Restock the various supplies necessary for performing lab test.
Abilit y to follow written and verbal instructions
Basic laboratory bench practice skills
Working knowledge of medical terminology
General typing/computer skills Must demonstrate excellent communication and customer service skills
Must have the ability to read, write and speak English
Ability to perform all phlebotomy functions including adult, pediatric and neonates
Ability to adapt to work load demands and remain calm and function efficiently during difficult or emergency situations
Ability to operate automated equipment under direct supervision
